_provenance.method: read-only osascript execute-javascript probe of a live ChatGPT tab in the user's own Chrome (gmail profile); no CDP, no mutation, no navigation
_provenance.purpose: yz-634: real nesting for the ancestor-clipping false positive. Geometry is measured, not reconstructed.

falsePositiveBand.note: A target here is below the scrollport's bottom edge (clipped, genuinely invisible) yet fully inside the browser viewport.

clippedTarget.why: The shim intersects the target rect against the viewport root rect only. 1128 + 36 = 1164 < 1187, so it is inside the viewport; but 1128 > 1121, so it is entirely outside its own scroll pane.
